models.name: asana__task
models.description: An enriched task table consisting of base task info + aggregated metrics and lists

columns.name: task_id
columns.description: System generated unique ID of the task.

columns.name: assignee_user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the ASANA_USER that is currently assigned the task.

columns.name: is_completed
columns.description: Boolean that is true if the task is currently marked complete.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the task was marked complete.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the task was created

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: Date the task is due, if provided.

columns.name: task_modified_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the task was last modified

columns.name: task_description
columns.description: Free-form text describing the task, as seen in the UI.

columns.name: workspace_id
columns.description: Foreign key reference to the workspace

columns.name: days_open
columns.description: The number of days the task has been/was open (creation -> completion)

columns.name: is_currently_assigned
columns.description: Boolean, true if the task is *currently* assigned

columns.name: has_been_assigned
columns.description: Boolean, true if the task has at one point been assigned, even if currently not.

columns.name: number_of_comments
columns.description: Count of comments made on the task

columns.name: number_of_followers
columns.description: Count of the users following the task

columns.name: tags
columns.description: A list of the tags associated with the task.

columns.name: number_of_tags
columns.description: Count of the tags associated with the task.

columns.name: is_subtask
columns.description: Boolean that's true if the task is a subtask of another.

models.name: asana__user
models.description: Enriched user table consisting of base user info + metrics around tasks and completions

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: System generated unique ID of the user

columns.name: email
columns.description: The user's email

columns.name: user_name
columns.description: Name of the user as it appears in the UI

columns.name: number_of_open_tasks
columns.description: Count of the currently open tasks assigned to this user

columns.name: number_of_tasks_completed
columns.description: Count of the tasks that this user has completed

columns.name: number_of_projects_owned
columns.description: Count of the projects that this user is the owner of (excludes archived projects)

columns.name: number_of_projects_currently_assigned_to
columns.description: Count of the projects that the user is currently assigned open tasks to.

models.name: asana__project
models.description: Table of projects' basic info enriched with metrics regarding tasks and completions

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: System-generated unique ID of the project.

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: UI-facing name of the project

columns.name: number_of_open_tasks
columns.description: Count of the currently open tasks in this project

columns.name: number_of_assigned_open_tasks
columns.description: Count of the open and assigned tasks in this project.

columns.name: number_of_tasks_completed
columns.description: Count of tasks that have been completed in this project

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the ASANA_TEAM that the project is associated with

columns.name: team_name
columns.description: User-facing name of the project's team

columns.name: is_archived
columns.description: Boolean representing if the project has been archived in the UI

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the project was created

columns.name: current_status
columns.description: The most recent progress status update for the project (free-form string)

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: The date the project is due on, if given

columns.name: last_modified_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the project was last modified (doesn't include comments or tasks)

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the USER who owns the project.

columns.name: number_of_users_involved
columns.description: Count of the unique users associated with the project

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-form textual description associated with project

models.name: asana__team
models.description: Enriched team table consisting of basic team info + task/completion metrics (note that teams can only act on tasks in projects)

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: System generate unique ID for the team

columns.name: team_name
columns.description: UI-facing name of the team.

columns.name: number_of_open_tasks
columns.description: Count of the currently open tasks for this team.

columns.name: number_of_assigned_open_tasks
columns.description: Count of the open and assigned tasks for the team.

columns.name: number_of_tasks_completed
columns.description: Count of tasks that this team has completed.

columns.name: number_of_active_projects
columns.description: Count of non-archived projects

columns.name: active_projects
columns.description: Comma-separated string of non-archived project IDs associated with the team, sorted alphabetically by project ID. NULL if the team has no active projects.

columns.name: number_of_archived_projects
columns.description: Count of archived projects

models.name: asana__tag
models.description: Table of tag basic info enriched with some task metrics.

columns.name: tag_id
columns.description: System-generated unique ID for the tag

columns.name: tag_name
columns.description: UI-facing name of the tag

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the tag was created

columns.name: number_of_open_tasks
columns.description: Count of the currently open tasks with this tag.

columns.name: number_of_assigned_open_tasks
columns.description: Count of the open and assigned tasks with this tag. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: number_of_tasks_completed
columns.description: Count of tasks with this tag that have been completed. Set to 0 if NULL.
